groups.name: Patient care
groups.shortDescription: Assessment, immediate help and continuing care under an experienced practitioner.

groups.name: Plant and remedy preparation
groups.shortDescription: Recognising medicinal material and turning it into dependable preparations.

groups.name: Operative care practice
groups.shortDescription: Deliberate operative instruction with the immediate care that surrounds it.

groups.name: Field surgical apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Operative care learned where casualties arrive from fighting.

groups.name: Distilling remedy workshop
groups.shortDescription: Preparation and dispensing that depends on a still.

groups.name: Bedside attendance practice
groups.shortDescription: Sustained attendance, observation, reporting and the household conduct it requires.
groups.note: Answers the previously zero-Skill attendant package without borrowing the physician's curriculum.

groups.name: Birth-attendance practice
groups.shortDescription: Specialist birth care taught together with the medical grounding it requires.
groups.note: Implements the approved Medicine -> Obstetrics correction (#231): the immediate parent is now supplied by the same practice.

groups.name: Stock medicine practice
groups.shortDescription: Differentiated animal clinical instruction supported by recurring cases.

groups.name: Naturalist field study
groups.shortDescription: Comparing living things in the field and recording what the comparison shows.

groups.name: Tracking and hunting practice
groups.shortDescription: Reading sign, approaching quarry unseen and taking it.

groups.name: Field travel and camp practice
groups.shortDescription: Moving, routing and living away from settlement.

groups.name: Mounted travel and animal care
groups.shortDescription: Riding and the daily care the animal needs.

groups.name: Trapline and trail practice
groups.shortDescription: Setting, running and reading a trapline.

groups.name: Pastoral stockkeeping apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Keeping and moving stock across the season.

groups.name: Draught-team and vehicle practice
groups.shortDescription: Team handling and vehicle control on repeated journeys.

groups.name: Falconry apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Training and hunting with a trained bird.

groups.name: Mixed crop-and-stock household practice
groups.shortDescription: Working a holding that carries both crops and animals.

groups.name: Running and athletic field practice
groups.shortDescription: Conditioned movement over distance, height and water.
groups.note: Revised: Swimming and Climbing added so conditioned movement is taught as one practice.

groups.name: Diving and underwater work practice
groups.shortDescription: Working below the surface on a line, and seeing what is down there.

groups.name: Small-craft boat working

groups.note: Replaces the one-Skill group G06 'Working a boat', whose taught practice was never only Seamanship.

groups.name: Rigged-vessel deck apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Deck and rigging work on a rigged vessel.

groups.name: Fishing-boat apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Working a fishing boat and taking fish from it.

groups.name: Passage navigation
groups.shortDescription: Bringing a vessel along a known passage.

groups.name: Charted open-water navigation practice
groups.shortDescription: Open-water navigation by chart and sky.

groups.name: Close-combat weapon practice
groups.shortDescription: Guard, defence and one actually taught weapon family.

selectionSlots.label: Choose one taught melee weapon family

groups.note: Restores the historical Basic Melee Training choose-one slot and, with it, general 2-h edged access. The approved catalogue reached 2-h edged only through F37 on two Soldier tracks.

groups.name: Advanced close-combat weapon practice
groups.shortDescription: Sustained instruction across several weapon families.

selectionSlots.label: Choose three taught melee weapon families

groups.note: Restores the historical Advanced Melee Training choose-three slot. The recovered import's choose-2 reading is recorded as an unresolved source conflict and is not silently adopted.

groups.name: Swashbuckling fencing instruction
groups.shortDescription: A named one-handed edged fencing tradition.
groups.note: Kept without a slot: the tradition is defined by its weapon, so an alternative family would not be the same practice.

groups.name: Formation arms drill
groups.shortDescription: Close-order drill with the arms the formation actually carries.

selectionSlots.label: Choose two taught formation weapon families

groups.note: Merges the three fixed formation groups. A soldier is charged for the arms actually issued and drilled, not for every weapon family the army fields.

groups.name: Mounted lance and troop drill
groups.shortDescription: Troop drill from horseback with lance and a sidearm.

selectionSlots.label: Choose one taught mounted sidearm family

groups.note: Revised: Riding made explicit, and the sidearm becomes a slot instead of a fixed 1-h edged charge.

groups.name: Military missile and formation practice
groups.shortDescription: Shooting in formation with the missile arm the unit is issued.

selectionSlots.label: Choose one taught missile weapon family

groups.note: Restores the historical Basic Missile Training choose-one slot and merges the three one-weapon military ranged groups.

groups.name: Advanced missile practice
groups.shortDescription: Sustained instruction across several missile families.

selectionSlots.label: Choose three taught missile weapon families

groups.note: Restores the historical Advanced Missile Training choose-three slot.

groups.name: Longbow hunting apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Hunting with the longbow as a taught tradition.

groups.name: Campaign service experience
groups.shortDescription: What repeated service in the field teaches that drill does not.

groups.name: Concealed field reconnaissance practice
groups.shortDescription: Observing an enemy without being observed.

groups.name: Unit coordination and command practice
groups.shortDescription: Handling a body of fighters under a responsible commander.

groups.name: Campaign staff practice
groups.shortDescription: Planning, supplying and recording a campaign rather than fighting it.

groups.name: Siege works practice
groups.shortDescription: Designing and building the works a siege needs.

groups.name: Siege engine crew practice
groups.shortDescription: Serving, laying and keeping a siege engine with its crew.

groups.name: Coercive service practice
groups.shortDescription: Applying pressure on behalf of someone who pays for it.

groups.name: General artisan apprenticeship

groups.note: Restores the historical Craft Specialty choose-one slot. The fixed members are the workshop conduct every apprenticeship teaches alongside the craft, not a second craft.

groups.name: Master artisan practice

groups.name: Construction site practice

groups.note: Restores the historical Construction Specialty choose-two slot.

groups.name: Fibre-to-cloth workshop practice
groups.shortDescription: Turning raw fibre into finished cloth.

groups.name: Leather and hide workshop
groups.shortDescription: Turning hide into usable material and finished goods.

groups.name: Garment workshop practice
groups.shortDescription: Cutting and making up cloth into fitted garments.

groups.name: Sail and canvas workshop
groups.shortDescription: Cutting, seaming and roping heavy canvas.

groups.name: Timber vessel construction
groups.shortDescription: Building a timber hull from frame to finish.

groups.name: Timber millwright apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Building and setting up working timber mechanisms.

groups.name: Building design and site surveying
groups.shortDescription: Designing a building and setting it out on its site.

groups.name: Stone workshop and quarry practice
groups.shortDescription: Winning stone and working it to a finished face.

groups.name: Mine and quarry apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Working an extraction face and getting in and out of it.

groups.name: Ironmaking and forge apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Winning metal from ore and forging it.

groups.name: Weapon-forge and servicing apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Making and maintaining weapons at the forge.

groups.name: Forged-metal armor workshop
groups.shortDescription: Making and fitting forged protective equipment.

groups.name: Lock and mechanism workshop
groups.shortDescription: Making, fitting and repairing locks and small mechanisms.

groups.name: Trap and device workshop
groups.shortDescription: Building constructed traps and setting them where they work.

groups.name: Modelled ceramic workshop
groups.shortDescription: Forming, modelling and firing ceramic.

groups.name: Seasonal kitchen and preservation practice
groups.shortDescription: Cooking through the season and keeping what the season gives.

groups.name: Brewhouse practice
groups.shortDescription: Running a brewhouse and the kitchen work that goes with it.

groups.name: Vineyard and winemaking practice
groups.shortDescription: Growing the fruit and making the wine from it.

groups.name: Alchemical workshop practice
groups.shortDescription: Sustained alchemical operation with the apparatus it needs.

groups.name: Records-office practice
groups.shortDescription: Keeping an establishment's records and accounts.

groups.name: Trading practice
groups.shortDescription: Buying, selling and judging what a thing is worth.

groups.name: Credit-house accounts and obligations
groups.shortDescription: Lending, obligation and the accounts that record them.

groups.name: Legal study and pleading practice
groups.shortDescription: Learning law and pleading it in its forum.

groups.name: Council and mediation practice
groups.shortDescription: Speaking, reading and settling among people who must go on living together.

groups.name: Court service practice
groups.shortDescription: Serving in a court and knowing how it is actually organised.

groups.name: Heraldic office practice
groups.shortDescription: Arms, descent and the ceremony that uses them.
groups.note: Closes the recorded Herald parent-access gaps: History (parent of Genealogy) and Customs (parent of Courtly Protocol) are now supplied inside the Herald's own envelope.

groups.name: Applied calculation practice
groups.shortDescription: Calculation put to work on accounts, measures and ground.

groups.name: Local contacts and information gathering
groups.shortDescription: Knowing who to ask and reading the answer.

groups.name: Covert entry practice
groups.shortDescription: Getting in unnoticed and past what is locked.

groups.name: Impersonation and distraction practice
groups.shortDescription: Appearing to be someone else and keeping the account standing up.

groups.name: Interview and evidence practice
groups.shortDescription: Questioning people and testing what they say against the evidence.

groups.name: Underworld association practice
groups.shortDescription: Moving inside an illicit milieu without being handed over.

groups.name: Gaming-house practice
groups.shortDescription: The games, the odds, the players and the hands.

groups.name: Documentary hand practice
groups.shortDescription: Reproducing a documentary hand convincingly enough to pass.

groups.name: Scholarly study practice
groups.shortDescription: Finding, holding and checking what is already known.

groups.name: Natural philosophy practice
groups.shortDescription: Arguing about what the world is, against what can be observed of it.

groups.name: Celestial observation practice
groups.shortDescription: Watching the sky methodically and calculating from it.

groups.name: Astrological reading practice
groups.shortDescription: Reading the sky for people, in a tradition that says how.

groups.name: Divinatory practice
groups.shortDescription: A maintained and reproducibly taught method of divination.

groups.name: Religious service practice
groups.shortDescription: Serving a religion in front of the people who practise it.

groups.name: Instruction and schooling practice
groups.shortDescription: Teaching deliberately, and being corrected on the teaching.

groups.name: Interpreting and language mediation practice
groups.shortDescription: Standing between two parties who do not share a language.
groups.note: The actual spoken languages remain separate contextual competencies. This group teaches the mediation practice, never a language.

groups.name: Chorographic and geographic study
groups.shortDescription: Assembling what is known about places and setting it down.

groups.name: Field surveying and map production
groups.shortDescription: Measuring ground and producing a map from the measurement.

groups.name: Speech and memory practice
groups.shortDescription: Composing and delivering from memory.

groups.name: Historical text investigation
groups.shortDescription: Reading older hands and arguing from what they say.

groups.name: Lineage investigation apprenticeship
groups.shortDescription: Establishing descent from the evidence that survives.

groups.name: Self-accompanied song practice
groups.shortDescription: Singing to one's own accompaniment.

groups.name: Dramatic acting and dance practice
groups.shortDescription: Playing a part and moving to time in front of an audience.

groups.name: Oral narrative composition and performance
groups.shortDescription: Composing and telling at length.

groups.name: Drawing and modelling workshop
groups.shortDescription: Drawing, painting and modelling under correction.
